source_text.slice: REQ-518 slice 2d (GH #2535): approver rule F1 on tasks (tasks.scope_node_id, Tasks.ScopeResolver, Tasks.in_scope/3, f1_allowed?/3, f1_recheck/3, Scope.allowed_for_role?/3 and allowed_set_for_role/2, ScopeGate.scope_set_for_role/3 and f1_principal/2, the :f1_scope step of claim_task and Engine.complete_task, task route classes (2 :filter, 5 resolver), docs/roles.md section). Tests only; nothing under lib/ or priv/ was changed; nothing committed.

task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-518 slice 2d (design r2b sections C.0-C.5, 7.1, 10.3: T-F1..T-F17, T-L12..T-L18, the mutants of 2d), REQ-518 ACs 12-17 and 20 (AC 13 as amended by PR #2810 incl. cases d2 and d3), the SEC code-gate (step-24) MERGE CONDITIONS and the REVIEWER (step-25) notes. Per-file runs only under the shared mixlock; no mix letflow.check.test, no full or multi-partition suite; mutants applied in memory only.

result.summary: 137 new tests in 8 new files plus the extended TaskScopeFixture, ALL GREEN, run per file, one mix at a time under the shared mixlock (MIX_ENV=test, default log level): tasks_scope_node_id_migration_test 9, scope_node_id_no_writer_scan_test 7, scope_for_role_test 27, f1_context_test 33, tasks_scope_http_test 18, tasks_scope_inv5_http_test 19, tasks_route_classes_test 11, roles_scoped_approvers_test 13. Neighbours green: engine/entity_writes_lock_order_test 5 and engine/module_write_lock_order_test 6 (UNEDITED, T-F17), engine_distinct_from_test 40, engine_distinct_from_concurrency_test 2, tasks_distinct_from_test 13 (T-F12), tasks_test + route_scope_walk_test + route_scope_resolver_test + route_scope_self_service_test 144 together, engine_complete_task_test green. mix format --check-formatted over every new or changed test file: 0. No compile warning in any new file. 43 mutants measured in memory: 42 killed, 1 survives (M2, equivalent by construction). NOT RUN (by instruction): mix letflow.check.test, any full or multi-partition suite. One environmental note: tasks_distinct_from_test A-15 asserts on a WARNING log line and fails under LOG_LEVEL=error (my first batch used it); at the default level it passes (13). No implementation bug found; one spec-vs-build observation (OBS-1).

implementation_findings: NO IMPLEMENTATION BUG FOUND: every test is green against the working tree and every mutant but the equivalent M2 is killed.

OBS-1 (spec vs build): AC 13 and design C.2 say Tasks.resolve_principal_scope/2 'is extended with the allowed node set'; as built it is NOT extended (map unchanged: user_id, group_ids, role_names) and the node set comes from ScopeGate.scope_set_for_role/3 and Scope.allowed_set_for_role/2. Functionally equivalent; the unchanged shape is pinned by a test. REVIEWER / DOC-UPDATER decide whether the sentence or the code moves.
OBS-2: claim_task and reassign_task write no audit entry (only assign_task writes task.assign); the audit test checks EVERY task entry so a future writer is covered.

OBS-3: M2 is equivalent: ScopeResolver.task_scope returning :unresolvable for a NULL node is defence in depth; the refusal of a NULL-node task for scoped callers is carried by the node-set predicate (in_scope, filter_by_scope) and by allowed_for_role? against :tenant_wide.

OBS-4 (as-built pin): at the context layer claim_task/complete_task answer task_not_pending for a non-pending task before the recheck; the router-level Tasks.in_scope/3 runs first, so completed and cancelled out-of-scope tasks give the same 404 over HTTP (tested).
OBS-5 (environment): tasks_distinct_from_test A-15 fails under LOG_LEVEL=error because it asserts on a WARNING line; it passes at the default level. Not an F1 regression.
OBS-6: the design text still names migration version 20261019100001 (REVIEWER F-4, CODE-DESIGNER/DOC-UPDATER); the tests use 20_261_019_200_001.
